translations.1: Then the sons of Israel journeyed, and encamped in the wilderness of Moab, which is by the Jordan of Jericho.
translations.2: And when Balak son of Zippor saw all that the people of Israel had done to the Amorites,
translations.3: the Moabites were greatly wary of the people, since they are numerous; and they were filled with dread because of them.
translations.4: And they said to the elders of Midian: 'Now this horde will lick up all the people around us, as the ox licks up the green of the wilderness.' And Balak son of Zippor was their king at that time.
translations.5: And he sent messengers to Balaam son of Beor, to Pethor which is on the Euphrates, the land of his people, to invite him; and said to him: 'Behold, a people has come out of Egypt — it has already covered the face of the land, and it sits encamped opposite me.
translations.6: And now, come and curse it for me, since they are stronger than I; perhaps I shall be able to fight against it and drive it out of the land — for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.'
translations.7: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian went, with divination-fees with them, until they reached Balaam, and told him the words of Balak.
translations.8: And he said to them: 'Lodge here tonight, and I shall bring you back an answer, as God shall say to me.' And the officers of Moab stayed with Balaam.
translations.9: And the decree of God came to Balaam, and said, opening the speech: 'Who are these people that are with you?'
translations.10: He said: 'Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent them to me,
translations.11: saying: Behold, the people that came out of Egypt has already covered the face of the land. Now come, curse it for me; perhaps I shall be able to fight against it and drive it out.'
translations.12: He said to him: 'Do not go with them, and do not curse the people — for it is blessed.'
translations.13: And he rose in the morning, and said to the officers of Balak: 'Go back to your land, for God has forbidden me to go with you.'
translations.14: And the officers of Moab arose, and came to Balak, and said: 'Balaam has refused to come with us.'
translations.15: And Balak again sent officers — greater and more honored than those.
translations.16: And they came to Balaam, and said to him: 'Thus says Balak son of Zippor: Do not hold yourself back from journeying to me.
translations.17: For I will honor you greatly, and whatever you say to me I will do — come, curse this people for me.'
translations.18: And Balaam answered the commanders of Balak, and said to them: 'Even if Balak were to give me his houseful of silver and gold, I cannot transgress the command of God my Lord, to do a small thing or a great thing.
translations.19: And now, stay here also tonight, that I may see what God will again address to me.'
translations.20: And the decree of God came to Balaam at night, and said: 'If these people have come to invite you, arise, go with them — but only the word that I shall tell you, that alone do.'
translations.21: And he rose in the morning, and saddled his she-donkey, and went with the officers of Moab.
translations.22: Then God's anger intensified at his going in greed; and the angel of God stood in the road to turn him away from that — while he was riding on his she-donkey and his two youths were with him.
translations.23: And when the she-donkey saw the angel of God standing in the road, with his sword drawn in his hand, she turned aside from the road and went through the fields; so Balaam struck her, to turn her back to the road.
translations.24: Then the angel of God stood in the narrow lane of the vineyards, with a wall on the right and on the left.
translations.25: And when she saw him, she pressed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall; so he added to his striking of her.
translations.26: And the angel of God passed on again, and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn aside from it right or left.
translations.27: And when she saw him, she lay down beneath Balaam; and Balaam's anger intensified, and he struck her with the staff.
translations.28: And God opened her mouth, and she said to Balaam: 'What have I done to you, that you have struck me — this third time?'
translations.29: He said: 'Because you have defied me — had I a sword in my hand, I would kill you now.'
translations.30: She said: 'Am I not your she-donkey on which you have ridden since I came to be until this day? Have I been accustomed to doing such a thing to you?' He said: 'No.'
translations.31: Then God uncovered Balaam's sight, and he saw the angel of God standing in the road, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he fell down before him prostrating.
translations.32: And the angel of God said to him: 'Why have you struck your she-donkey this third time? I have come out to turn you aside — for the road before me has become an entanglement.'
translations.33: Until she saw me and turned aside from me — this third time. Had she not turned aside from me, I would have killed you now and let her live.'
translations.34: He said to him: 'I have erred, for I did not know that you were standing to meet me in the road. And now, if my going is displeasing to you, I shall turn back.'
translations.35: He said to him: 'Go with the people — but only the word that I shall tell you, speak that alone.' And he went with them.
translations.36: And when Balak heard of the coming of Balaam, he went out to meet him at the town of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is at its edge.
translations.37: Balak said to Balaam: 'Did I not send to you once before this to invite you? Why did you not come to me? Do you suppose I am unable to honor you?'
translations.38: He said: 'And now I have indeed come to you — but do you suppose I am able to say anything, except only what God will prompt me with?'
translations.39: And the two of them went together, until they came to the town of Hutzoth.
translations.40: And Balak slaughtered cattle and sheep, and sent of that to Balaam and to the officers who were with him.
translations.41: And it was in the morning: Balak took Balaam and brought him up to some of the high-places of his deity, and from there he saw a portion of the people.
